newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD shrugs off gold estimates.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD shrugs off gold estimates.

text.p: Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) has described as premature yet another newspaper report confirming huge gold reserves in the firm's mining area in northern Brazil.
Folha de Sao Paulo newspaper said a CVRD consultant had confirmed that a gold deposit in the Carajas mining area in Para state announced by CVRD in October last year contained 500 tonnes of gold.

"Everything is possible, but the company has not carried out enough surveys to determine how large the deposit is," a CVRD spokesman said. "Whoever says they can confirm the size of the deposit is guessing."

He said at least a total of 90,000 meters (270,000 feet) would have to be drilled before there could be any definite estimate of the amount of gold, and this would take another one and a half to two years.
He said CVRD would issue regular information to the stock exchanges on the ongoing survey work every three months, with the next update to be released probably in April.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
